last30DaysByDefaultUnknownCostsRequire: Last 30 days by default. Unknown costs require reconciliation; they are not zero. Payments and point consumption are separate measures. Wallet balances and open reviews are current totals.
configuredOrderApplicationFilteringRemai: Models are requested in configured order. Application filtering remains active during gateway sync failures. An unavailable gateway is never bypassed.
modelRequestOrderHint: Default DeepSeek requests use configured fallback routes in order; explicit GLM and GPT requests stay on their selected routes.
amountsRetainTheirOriginalPrecisionNullM: Amounts retain their original precision; null means unknown or not applicable.
pointsOnlyNoCashRefundsRefundsRequireAn: Points only; no cash refunds. Refunds require an original debit. Expired monthly points remain expired.
thisRecordsTheResolutionCompletePointAdj: This records the resolution. Complete point adjustments first, then attach the ledger ID.
afdianTradeOptional: Afdian transaction (optional; verifies payment and resolves review)
referralRules: Permanent credits are issued after an invited user registers, verifies their email and authenticates with Skland. The referral limit applies to inviters. Updated rules apply to future payouts. Settled amounts stay as recorded.
referralPauseRules: Disabling pauses new referral attribution and credit awards. Existing records remain, and enabling again does not reset the limit.
deepseekFirstGlmOnFailureApplicationFilt: Default DeepSeek requests use configured fallback routes; explicit GLM and GPT choices stay fixed. Application filtering and billing remain active.
modelUsageSummaryHint: Covers model calls across the current filters, including tool continuations. Total input includes both cache reads and writes; both columns are parts of that total. Amounts are known model costs and calculated prices; the ledger determines final point deductions. Unconfirmed records are counted separately. Missing cache-write usage is shown as “Not recorded”, not zero.
gatewayModelUsageHint: Totals deduplicate model calls. Each gateway row shows the usage and cost of its whole related call; multiple attempts may share one call. Unlinked requests are not assigned estimated charges.
